newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African wool prices fall at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: South African wool prices fall at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices fell at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 12,967 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 98.8 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron rose 0.5 percent, 21 micron fell 1.3 percent, 22 micron fell 0.5 percent, 23 micron fell 1.4 percent, 24 micron fell 1.6 percent and 25 micron fell 0.9 percent.

Prices for Merino bellies fell 0.8 percent, Merino lambs was unchanged and Merino locks rose 0.4 percent. The offering included 2,197 bales of other White Wools, 8 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 122 bales of Lesotho and 405 bales of coarse and coloured.

Of the 20, 24 and 25 micron offered, one hundred percent was sold. Of the 1,370 bales of 21 micron offered, 98.8 percent was sold. Of 2,365 bales of 22 micron offered, 98.7 percent was sold and of the 1,737 bales of 23 micron was offered, which sold 98.7 percent was sold.
The next sale will take place on 13 November, when the offering will be 10,000 bales.
